% test-explprim's expl3 copies of pdfTeX's primitives in a document that
% loads hyperref and leaves \pdfoutput unset. A heading's text goes to the
% table of contents and to hyperref's bookmarks, the expandable
% \tex_pdfxformname:D in one of them.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\ExplSyntaxOn
\NewDocumentCommand \blue { m }
    { \tex_pdfliteral:D { 0~0~1~rg } #1 \tex_pdfliteral:D { 0~g } }
\ExplSyntaxOff
\begin{document}
\tableofcontents

\section{Head \blue{x} end}\label{head}

Literal: before \blue{one} after, a link to section~\ref{head}.

Link: before\ExplSyntaxOn \tex_pdfstartlink:D goto~name {section.1} to~the~head
\tex_pdfendlink:D \ExplSyntaxOff{} after.

Stack: before\ExplSyntaxOn \tex_pdfcolorstack:D 0~push {0~0~1~rg} pushed
\tex_pdfcolorstack:D 0~pop \ExplSyntaxOff{} after.

Footnote: before\footnote{Note \blue{six} end.} after.

\setbox2\hbox{form}%
\ExplSyntaxOn \tex_pdfxform:D 2 \ExplSyntaxOff
\ExplSyntaxOn
\section{Name~[\tex_pdfxformname:D \tex_pdflastxform:D]~end}
\ExplSyntaxOff

\end{document}
